standard.summary: Pilot 不看瞬时的梯度范数，而是看最近 N 步的中位数，避免单步尖峰误触发。
standard.effect: 默认 10。设小于 1 启动报错；1 = 完全不平滑。
standard.whenToUse: 单步尖峰频繁误触发时保持或调大。
standard.avoidWhen: 窗口太大会让真实的事故响应变慢。

standard_en.summary: The Pilot compares thresholds against the median of the last N global grad norms instead of the raw instant, so one-off spikes do not trigger it.
standard_en.effect: Default 10. Below 1 fails closed; 1 = no smoothing.
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep or raise when single-step spikes cause false triggers.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Too wide a window delays real incident response.
